entries.menuText: "We must focus on raising our public opinion and start campaigning for the next election already."

entries.dialogueText: "The state of our economy is very concerning. It must be our focus to achieve quick economic development."
entries.menuText: "The state of our economy is very concerning. It must be our focus to achieve quick economic development."

entries.menuText: "Economy will be our number one priority until the end of our term. We will aim to boost it further."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's time to focus on changing our..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's time to focus on changing our party as a whole. I will add a new vision in our manifesto."
entries.menuText: "It's time to focus on changing our party as a whole. I will add a new vision in our manifesto."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabinet looked uneasy. Lileas s..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabinet looked uneasy. Lileas spoke with a concerned look in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Symon nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm sorry?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland needs to become an econom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland needs to become an economic powerhouse."
entries.menuText: "Sordland needs to become an economic powerhouse."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't get elected if we do not..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't get elected if we do not improve the economy."
entries.menuText: "We can't get elected if we do not improve the economy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should focus on eliminating pov..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should focus on eliminating poverty and homelessness."
entries.menuText: "We should focus on eliminating poverty and homelessness."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must convince the public that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must convince the public that the emergency was useful."
entries.menuText: "We must convince the public that the emergency was useful."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should put more focus on our co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should put more focus on our constitutional victory."
entries.menuText: "We should put more focus on our constitutional victory."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should blame the opposition for..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should blame the opposition for the failure of the reforms."
entries.menuText: "We should blame the opposition for the failure of the reforms."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't get elected if we do not..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't get elected if we do not convince the public in some way."
entries.menuText: "We can't get elected if we do not convince the public in some way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a mixed response, but the..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a mixed response, but the majority seemed to be in agreement with me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Almost everybody seemed to be in ag..."
entries.dialogueText: Almost everybody seemed to be in agreement with me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's time USP shifts away from Sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's time USP shifts away from Sollism."
entries.menuText: "It's time USP shifts away from Sollism."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As I said, I will reform our party..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, I will reform our party platform."
entries.menuText: "As I said, I will reform our party platform."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I see. And the party leadership wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. And the party leadership will agree with that?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You see, I am the current chairman..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see, I am the current chairman Mrs. Graf..."
entries.menuText: "You see, I am the current chairman Mrs. Graf..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you not agree with that, Mrs. G..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you not agree with that, Mrs. Graf?"
entries.menuText: "Do you not agree with that, Mrs. Graf?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I just wanted to announce this ear..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to announce this earlier, so you are aware. I won't change my mind."
entries.menuText: "I just wanted to announce this earlier, so you are aware. I won't change my mind."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If there are no comments, let's mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there are no comments, let's move on with the meeting."
entries.menuText: "If there are no comments, let's move on with the meeting."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You'll learn about my thoughts if..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll learn about my thoughts if you bring your suggestions to the leadership."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You are right about that. However,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right about that. However, the party does not belong to you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""That was the extent of my comments..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was the extent of my comments. We can move on."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your comments.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your comments."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for your comments."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Frankly, I don't care what you thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. It has already been decided."
entries.menuText: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. It has already been decided."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If there are no comments, I want t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there are no comments, I want to talk about another plan."
entries.menuText: "If there are no comments, I want to talk about another plan."

entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef narrowed his eyes and stared..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef narrowed his eyes and stared at me. I couldn't help but feel uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I have no words. And nobody else i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no words. And nobody else is going to react?"

entries.dialogueText: Lileas stood up and took a long look at the ministers around the table.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I cannot believe this administrati..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot believe this administration comes from the United Sordland Party."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A lot of people suffered under Sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lot of people suffered under Soll. Justice must be served."

entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I thought you respected Sollism. I..."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.title: Player: ""I asked you something.""

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
